name.zh: 漁人的女性長輩：地瓜田採收
name.en: Iratay woman elder: sweet potato harvest

text.unlockEn: Sweet potato, permission to dig in the sweet potato field

steps.text: 漁人的女性長輩請你幫忙挖地瓜
steps.textEn: The Iratay woman elder asks you to help dig sweet potatoes

lines.zh: 地瓜可以挖了。田是我們家的，你來幫忙，挖到的分你一些。
lines.en: The sweet potatoes are ready. The field is our family's — help me, and I'll share some of what we dig.

steps.text: 到漁人的地瓜田，跟著長輩把地瓜挖出來
steps.textEn: Go to the Iratay sweet potato field and dig sweet potatoes with the elder

lines.zh: 這顆好大！
lines.en: This one's huge!

lines.zh: 輕一點，不要把它挖破了。
lines.en: Gently. Don't break it while digging.

steps.text: 向漁人的女性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the Iratay woman elder

lines.zh: 辛苦了，這些拿去。以後要地瓜，先跟我說一聲，就可以來田裡挖。
lines.en: Thanks for your help. Take these. If you want sweet potatoes later, just tell me first and you can dig in the field.

hint.zh: 漁人的女性長輩要採收地瓜，去幫忙吧。
hint.en: The Iratay woman elder is harvesting sweet potatoes. Go help.

name.zh: 漁人的長輩：族男跟船組再出海
name.en: Iratay elder: the Tao man goes to sea with the crew again

review: 漁團出海與分魚的公開程度

text.coop: 族男單獨（其他人在岸邊等）
text.coopEn: Tao man alone (the others wait on shore)
text.unlockEn: Trust of the Iratay elder, flying fish

steps.text: 族男向漁人的長輩領出海的工作
steps.textEn: The Tao man takes the job of going to sea from the Iratay elder

lines.zh: 聽說你在椰油出過海了。今天跟我們漁人的船組出去，一樣，只有你去。
lines.en: I hear you've been to sea in Yayo. Today, go out with our Iratay crew. Same as before — only you go.

lines.zh: 海況不好就回來，沒有人會笑你。
lines.en: If the sea is bad, come back. No one will laugh at you.

lines.zh: 出海期間只能操控族男，族女與旅人在漁人灘頭等。捕到魚，或按「放棄出海」，才會回來會合。
lines.en: While at sea, you can only control the Tao man; the Tao woman and traveller wait on the Iratay beach. Catch a fish, or tap "Give up", to come back and rejoin them.

solo.taskEn: at sea with the Iratay boat crew

giveUp.zh: 回來了？好，平安最重要。下次再出去。
giveUp.en: Back already? Good. Safety comes first. Go out again next time.

steps.text: 族男划拼板舟出海，看準飛魚躍出的時機（失敗可再試，或放棄出海）
steps.textEn: The Tao man paddles the plank boat out and waits for the moment a flying fish leaps (try again if you miss, or give up)

lines.zh: 捕到了！划回去。
lines.en: Caught one! Paddle back.

steps.text: 族男回到漁人灘頭，和族女、旅人會合
steps.textEn: The Tao man returns to the Iratay beach and meets the Tao woman and the traveller

lines.zh: 回來了！
lines.en: You're back!

lines.zh: 我們一直在這裡等，沒有靠近船。
lines.en: We waited right here the whole time and didn't go near the boats.

steps.textEn: The Tao man reports to the Iratay elder

lines.zh: 平安回來就好。魚先分給船組，再帶一點回家給長輩。
lines.en: As long as you're back safe. Share the fish with the crew first, then take some home for the elders.

lines.zh: 你阿公如果看到，一定很高興。
lines.en: If your grandpa could see you, he'd be so happy.

hint.zh: 飛魚季時，漁人的長輩會邀族男跟漁人的船組出海；只有族男能去。
hint.en: In flying fish season, the Iratay elder will invite the Tao man to go to sea with the Iratay crew. Only the Tao man can go.

name.zh: 漁人的族人：從機場回來的阿嬤
name.en: Iratay villager: Grandma back from the airport

steps.text: 漁人的族人要去機場接媽媽
steps.textEn: An Iratay villager is going to pick up his mum at the airport

lines.zh: 我媽媽去臺灣的醫院檢查，今天坐飛機回來。島上沒有大醫院，看病要跑來跑去。
lines.en: My mum went to a hospital in Taiwan for a check-up, and she's flying back today. There's no big hospital on the island, so seeing a doctor means a lot of travel.

lines.zh: 可以幫我去機場提行李嗎？我還要先去準備車子。
lines.en: Could you go help with her bags at the airport? I need to get the car ready first.

steps.text: 到蘭嶼機場幫阿嬤提行李
steps.textEn: Go to Lanyu Airport and help Grandma with her bags

lines.zh: 阿嬤，行李給我拿就好！
lines.en: Grandma, let me carry your bags!

lines.zh: 阿嬤笑著把醫院的資料袋交給你，請你拿去衛生所。
lines.en: Smiling, Grandma hands you the hospital papers and asks you to take them to the health station.

steps.text: 把醫院的資料交給衛生所護理師
steps.textEn: Give the hospital papers to the health station nurse

lines.zh: 謝謝，我們會照著臺灣醫院的建議，定期去家裡看阿嬤。
lines.en: Thank you. We'll follow the Taiwan hospital's advice and visit Grandma at home regularly.

lines.zh: 島上的長輩看病不容易，大家互相幫忙很重要。
lines.en: Seeing a doctor isn't easy for the island's elders. It matters that people help each other.

lines.zh: 真的太謝謝你們了。我媽說，下次要煮地瓜給你們吃。
lines.en: Thank you so much. My mum says she'll cook sweet potatoes for you next time.

hint.zh: 漁人的族人要去機場接剛看完病回來的媽媽。
hint.en: An Iratay villager is going to the airport to pick up his mum, back from seeing a doctor.

name.zh: 漁人的族人：晚會的邀請
name.en: Iratay villager: an invitation to the evening party

steps.text: 漁人的族人邀大家參加部落的晚會
steps.textEn: An Iratay villager invites everyone to the village's evening party

lines.zh: 這幾天晚上，學校操場有部落的晚會，大家一起吃東西、聽孩子唱歌。你們三個一起來吧！
lines.en: These next few nights there's a village party on the school field. We eat together and listen to the kids sing. All three of you, come!

lines.zh: 旅人不用特別打扮。真的想戴點什麼，可以請族女幫你縫個小東西，紅頭的織布長輩會教。
lines.en: The traveller doesn't need to dress up. If you really want to wear something, ask the Tao woman to sew you something small — the Imorod weaving elder can teach her.

toast: 晚上到漁人的學校操場參加晚會（NT4）。
toastEn: Go to the evening party at the Iratay school field at night (NT4).

hint.zh: 漁人的族人好像有好消息要說。
hint.en: An Iratay villager seems to have good news.
